2115431834469167469.en_summary: @RedDogT3 urges traders not to chase the rally. $SPY and $QQQ have had three constructive sessions, but $SPY is still in a range dating back to Aug. 4, with the $771 area a level where he might trim. With markets pricing about a 90% chance of no rate change at the 2 p.m. FOMC, he warns hawkish comments from Fed Chair Warsh could trigger selling and would reduce exposure beforehand. He sees $TSLA as a genuine breakout after clearing $388 and pushing above $397, but on Day 4 of its advance he prefers not to chase. He calls $NVDA, $MU, $SNDK and $NBIS broken bounces, would not hold $GOOGL through earnings with its 200-day average near $327, sees $AMZN follow-through as unproven, and flags dilution concerns for $SPCX with $140.60 as a risk level. A video thumbnail is attached.
2115431834469167469.zh_summary: @RedDogT3 提醒交易者不要追漲。$SPY 與 $QQQ 已連續三個交易日走勢良好，但 $SPY 仍處於 8 月 4 日以來的區間，771 美元附近是他可能減持的位置。市場預期下午 2 時聯儲局議息維持利率不變的機率約 90%，他警告聯儲局主席 Warsh 若發表意外鷹派言論可能引發拋售，因此會在公布前降低倉位。他認為 $TSLA 突破 388 美元並站上 397 美元屬真正突破，但已是上漲第四天，不宜追高。他認為 $NVDA、$MU、$SNDK 與 $NBIS 只是破位後的反彈；不會持有 $GOOGL 過業績，其 200 日均線約在 327 美元；$AMZN 的後續動能仍未獲證實；$SPCX 則有攤薄疑慮，140.60 美元為風險控制位。附上影片縮圖。

2115433259349795033.en_summary: (Reposted by @saxena_puru) @BjerkeOy lists SK Hynix $SKHY Q3 highlights: revenue up 328% YoY and 32% QoQ, operating profit up 632% YoY and 38% QoQ, long-term agreements with 14 customers, typically five years, covering more than 50% of 2027 to 2028 capacity, DRAM and HBM effectively sold out through 2029, and fab shells being built first with clean rooms opened in phases to manage oversupply risk.
2115433259349795033.zh_summary: （由 @saxena_puru 轉發）@BjerkeOy 列出 SK 海力士 $SKHY 第三季重點：營收按年增長 328%、按季增長 32%；營業利潤按年增長 632%、按季增長 38%；與 14 家客戶簽訂通常為期五年的長期協議，涵蓋 2027 至 2028 年逾 50% 產能；DRAM 與 HBM 實際上已售罄至 2029 年；為控制未來供過於求的風險，公司先建廠房外殼，再按需求分階段啟用無塵室。
